blocking_finding: P0-CONTRACT-IDENTITY-01: contract.md freezes the R1 identity while the binding and profile freeze the r75 capacity identity
next_action: run Load Generator Qualification against the r75 identity; before any Formal tier, re-obtain G1/G2/G3 on the r75 binaries and settle P0-CONTRACT-IDENTITY-01
why_the_frozen_identity_moved_off_r72: The r72 binaries never renewed a farm subscription lease: both subscription dispatches called the pooled Holder client without the route it reads off the outgoing context, so every renewal failed inside the client before dialling. Measured on r72 under load, unexpected_lease_expiry_total reached 8736 and climbing. That is a hard correctness gate, so no load behaviour on r72 could have produced a capacity number.
acceptance_re_run_required_before_formal: G1/G2/G3 were obtained on r70, whose binaries predate the lease fix. The fix changes the very subscription path G1 exercises, so the r72 per-binary equality receipt does not carry to r75 and acceptance has to be re-obtained on the r75 binaries before any Formal tier. Load Generator Qualification is exempt because it measures the generator, not the service.
